title: Planet Tweaks V3.5.6 - Planet AI Power-Up, Redesigned Key Remapper, Game Booster Grouping & Mouse Forensic Tracer
releaseNotes: Planet Tweaks V3.5.6 (2026-11-26): (1) Planet AI Major Power-Up: Added Free-Tier ($0) Model Switcher (Auto, Gemini 4, Gemini 3.8 Flash, Gemini 3.5 Lite), persistent Custom AI Rules drawer (strictly contained as untrusted preferences outside immutable system rules), clean formatted Markdown message rendering, and 9 new verified Execute-Mode PC tools including real app launching (open_app so Chrome launches instead of winget), list_installed_apps, open_url, open_folder, create_desktop_shortcut, set_power_plan, toggle_timer_resolution, Windows Core Audio COM set_system_volume with live readback verification, and strictly allowlisted single-statement diagnostic commands (25 verified tools total). (2) Keyboard & Media Remapper Redesign: Rebuilt from the ground up with a clean 2-row unclipped header, breathable card rows, unclipped Instant (Hook) vs Kernel (Scancode Map) pills, and sticky Save & Apply footer. (3) Responsive Top Bar & Zero Clipped Tabs: Removed duplicate top-bar profile pill, pinned Minimize/Maximize/Close permanently, auto-compacts top bar when resized, and wraps Settings sub-tabs cleanly. (4) Game Booster 1-Click App Grouping & Audio Driver Shield: Groups multi-process apps (Spotify, Brave, Chrome, Edge, Discord, Steam, OBS, StarDesk, Medal, GeForce NOW) into 1-click rows and shields critical audio & GPU drivers (RtkAudUService64, Voicemod, EqualizerAPO, Voicemeeter, Sonar, Nahimic, AMD Noise Suppression). (5) Live CPU Temp Unfreeze & Spec Switcher Sync: High-Precision PDH thermal recovery + automatic Dashboard/My PC identity sync on startup and reboot. (6) Input Forensics, Discord Debloat & Lean Single Edition: Added live WM_INPUT Mouse-Jump & Stuck-Click Forensic Tracer, opt-in MouseDataQueueSize=8, symmetrical 8x8 Double-Click Hitbox, Laptop External-Mouse Guard (exact existence-aware Undo), Discord Clips/Debug/Auto-Start debloat, read-only msconfig numproc/RAM cap detector, and permanently retired the 1.1 GB Nova AI Edition.
